**2) Main Surface Content:**
The main area displays the **Appearance** settings. It features a "Theme" section with three visual preview options: **System**, **Light**, and **Dark**. Below the previews are two code blocks showing theme configuration objects (one for a light sidebar, one for an elevated/dark sidebar). Further down is a customization section labeled "**Light theme**" containing fields for **Accent** (set to `#339CFF`), **Background** (`#FFFFFF`), and **Foreground** (`#1A1C1F`), along with buttons for "Import", "Copy theme", and "Codex".

**3) Selected Project/Item in Sidebar:**
**Appearance** (It is highlighted with a light grey background and has an 'x' icon next to it).

**4) Footer/Status Text (Verbatim):**
